plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 1927 & October 1942 (Charles Elton maps Arctic food webs and the Pyramid of Numbers, and Raymond Lindeman at Cedar Bog Lake proves the 10% trophic energy law) · 27 September 1962 (Rachel Carson in Silent Spring proves persistent toxins like DDT biomagnify tens of thousands of times up the food chain) · June 1963–1969 & 1974–1995 (Robert Paine pries Pisaster starfish off Mukkaw Bay rocks to discover keystone species and trophic cascades, followed by James Estes's sea otters and Yellowstone's wolves).
